cohort: 49 women with acute kidney injury and hemolytic uremic syndrome during pregnancy or postpartum
finding: Acute kidney injury with hemolytic uremic syndrome during pregnancy or postpartum may lead to irreversible kidney damage in many young women, but plasmapheresis was associated with better renal recovery.
mod_finding: The study examined acute kidney injury in association with hemolytic uremic syndrome during pregnancy or postpartum, but did not specifically analyze mode of delivery.
